title: Fun Idea
text: Fun Idea. I love baking and trying out new cupcake flavors. I was excited to give this a try. It's a fun idea to make apple pie flavored cupcakes, but the end results are just so-so. It was easy to use the packets of flavoring, but the finished taste was too artificial. Of course, my family did eat them, but they all agreed that they didn't recommend getting them again. In addition to the flavor packets, the kit also includes disposable icing bags, icing tips and cupcake liners which are things we go through a lot of during baking season.

product_metadata.title: Wilton Coffee, Caramel and Mocha Flavors Cupcake Baking and Decorating Set, 5-Piece
features: Bake and decorate delicious coffee, mocha and caramel flavored cupcakes with included flavorings, sprinkles and tools
Includes: Coffee, caramel and mocha flavor packets, 3 large decorating tips, 7 disposable decorating bags, 75 cupcake liners and vanilla jimmies
Flavor pouches total net weight: 0.75 oz. (21 g); jimmies net weight: 1.76 oz. (50 g)
Flavor pouches certified kosher; made on equipment that also processes peanuts, soy, wheat and tree nuts; made in a facility that also processes egg and fish
Jimmies certified kosher; contain no artificial flavors or colors; contain no high-fructose corn syrup; contain soy; made on equipment that also processes tree nuts
Decorating bags and tips both made from plastic
Before first and after each use, wash tips in warm, soapy water
In order to help cut down on extra packaging waste, each individual product in your set will arrive together in the same plain brown box
description: Easily make and decorate delicious flavored cupcakes that taste and look like you spent a ton of time on them with our pre-measured coffee, mocha and caramel flavorings. Our disposable decorating bags make cleanup a snap, and our tips help you both fill and top your cupcakes with your favorite frosting or filling. We've even included cupcake liners you can use for any occasion, and some yummy vanilla jimmies sprinkles to top everything off with a little something sweet.
